name: o9703

kind.description: Defines that the message is a request

id.description: Request ID generated by the client. It should be unique per WebSocket session in order to identify the request. This ID will be reflected by the server in the response to the request.

type.description: Contains one of the APIs request type names

description:
Dear Service Team,

I am sending a request (kind: req) identified by the ID **abc123**. The purpose of this message is to invoke the **getUserInfo** operation. Please process this request at your earliest convenience.
